_comment: Everything the analyst's trusted controller may do in AWS, shared by every Subagent
security sample. A setup script drops this key and fills in <BUCKET> and the Bedrock
<MODEL_RESOURCES> list, which it reads from the configured inference profile.
The prefixes are what make the page's refusals real rather than arranged: reading a
proposal is allowed, overwriting one is not, and another case's objects are outside
every Resource here. s3:PutObject is granted on the reports prefix only, so the
controller can save a recommendation and cannot change a source document.
The restricted tool roles have no AWS role at all. They are processes inside the
pod, not pods of their own, so they have no Pod Identity association, and the
sample shows them refused the projected token file and the Pod Identity endpoint.
